declaration_boundary: Synthetic expected input/observation data for future admitted source adapters. This schema is neither production wire protocol nor executable replay code. No live state injection, engine import/run, observer hook insertion or new mode admission.
expected_ledger_boundary: Only transcribes expected same-body positions/reveals/deaths/returns/revival for static data referential checks; does not compute geometry, legal moves, royal safety, hero abilities, counters, projections, clocks or terminal results. No predicted or actual PASS is recorded for any game specification.

common_observation_contract.formal_boundaries: Every listed normal turn expects one actual normal begin, one source-prescribed committed main and one normal end; successful non-main skills and refusals do not create extra normal opportunities or reset deadlines.
common_observation_contract.within_atom: Before/closed-after snapshots and existing synchronous read-only evidence only; internal six-step/path/endpoint ordering is source obligation, not additional invocable actions or mandatory engine callbacks.
common_observation_contract.clock: Original deadline and formal opportunity identity compared, not identical remaining milliseconds after elapsed time. Both D01 first normal turns75sec per original source; later times by existing source; no new clock implementation.
common_observation_contract.view: Authority-only identity/alias maps not player fields. Preserve both raw player outputs and observable actions/messages/errors; do not invent masks to hide leakage. Exact views/normalization remain unverified.
common_observation_contract.D01: Only legally triggered H06/H05 D01 replacement; no ordinary H06 rewind/H05 time ability, H15, H11 or second mutation. Six-step safe result source guard preserved.
common_observation_contract.PD: H04/H03 with only M01 orM04; no added traps, M07, flight or dragon scales; half_chaos H03 departure/royal armor retained. Longest red turn7 remains below H04 unlock.
